title: Daily briefing: Physics Nobel for founder of neutrino-hunting observatory
title_zh: 每日简报：中微子探测观测站创始人获物理诺贝尔奖
abstract: Francis Halzen has won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work in founding the IceCube Neutrino Observatory. Plus, a call to prevent a privacy crisis driven by smart glasses and has flu season come early?
abstract_zh: 弗朗西斯·哈尔森因创立冰立方中微子观测站而获得物理学诺贝尔奖。此外，他呼吁防止由智能眼镜引发的隐私危机，并质疑流感季节是否提前到来？
